en: Fixes the crash when opening a book with characters the UI font lacks
Fixes the short std::terminate abort from unset callbacks
Crash screen now shows fault codes and can be paged
Cached books survive an erase-device flash (hardware-bound keys)
Missing-glyph boxes after using the network are gone
Update data packs and the PDF engine together with this release
zh: 修复打开含生僻字书籍时的崩溃
修复空回调导致的短 abort 崩溃
崩溃屏显示故障码并可翻页
整片擦除刷写不再让已缓存书籍失效（密钥绑定硬件）
联网后不再出现缺字方框
请与固件一并更新数据包与 PDF 引擎
